question: After real Microsoft Teams or production Bot Framework delivery proof is supplied, should this PR or https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/95867 be the canonical landing branch?
rationale: Both branches implement the same one-line production hook, neither currently satisfies the external-PR real-behavior gate, and choosing between their different test and export shapes requires maintainer intent.

options.title: Use this PR

options.title: Use the older PR
options.body: Prefer https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/95867 if its smaller test shape and adapter export are desired, then close this PR after that branch gains sufficient proof.
